description: Bilan des comptages routiers mensuels depuis 2021 is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Data64. Comptages routiers issue de la plateforme webtrafic qui récupère quotidiennement les volumes de trafic horaire de chaque compteurs du Département des Pyrénées Atlantiques. Ces compteurs sont disséminés uniquement sur les routes départementales. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. The portal shows 25,567 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-10-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
